title: ptestR — Permutation Tests for R
text: R package providing permutation-based significance testing generalised linear models, linear mixed-effects models, binomial logistic regression. Designed small non-normally distributed neuroscience datasets standard asymptotic p-values unreliable.

title: ptestR — Permutation Tests for R
text: ptestR wraps glm, lme4::lmer, binomial glm permutation loop: model, generates null distribution test statistic randomly rearranging outcome variable (permNum times), computes p.perm proportion permuted statistics least extreme observed one. approach requires far fewer distributional assumptions standard likelihood-ratio Wald tests, making well-suited neuroimaging, EEG, biomedical datasets repeated measures small samples. package developed used : França LGS, Ciarrusta J, Gale-Grant O, Fenn-Moltu S, Fitzgibbon S, Chew , Falconer S, Dimitrova R, Cordero-Grande L, Price , Hughes E, O’Muircheartaigh J, Duff E, Tuulari JJ, Deco G, Counsell SJ, Hajnal JV, Nosarti C, Arichi T, Edwards AD, McAlonan G, Batalle D (2024). Neonatal brain dynamic functional connectivity term preterm infants association early childhood neurodevelopment. Nature Communications, 15, 16. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-023-44050-z study, grouped_perm_glm grouped_perm_glmm used 10 000 permutations (two-sided, FDR-corrected α = 5%) test associations neonatal fMRI brain state features postmenstrual age, postnatal days, preterm birth, neurodevelopmental outcomes (Bayley-III Q-CHAT) 18 months age 390 term- preterm-born neonates developing Human Connectome Project (dHCP). also used : Ferré IBS, Corso G, dos Santos Lima GZ, Lopes SR, Leocadio-Miguel MA, França LGS, de Lima Prado T, Araújo JF (2024). Cycling reduces entropy neuronal activity human adult cortex. PLOS ONE, 19(10): e0298703. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0298703

title: ptestR — Permutation Tests for R
text: Permutation test generalised linear models. Returns tibble columns: term, estimate, statistic, p.value, p.perm. Example:
code: grouped_perm_glm(tbl, formla, var_to_perm, family = gaussian,                  permNum = 1000, seed = 42) library(ptestR)  counts    <- sample(1:100, 9, replace = TRUE) outcomes  <- c(18, 17, 15, 20, 10, 20, 25, 13, 12) treatment <- gl(3, 3) TBL <- data.frame(counts, outcomes, treatment)  grouped_perm_glm(TBL, outcomes ~ counts + treatment, "outcomes")

title: ptestR — Permutation Tests for R
text: Permutation test linear mixed-effects models. permutation applied fixed effects; random effects structure preserved. Returns tibble columns: term, effect, estimate, statistic, p.perm. Note: p.perm replaces conventional p.value lme4::lmer compute degrees freedom p-values default. permutation p-value fully nonparametric alternative. Example: Typical usage pattern grouped analysis (applied per brain state, dHCP neonatal study):
code: grouped_perm_glmm(tbl, formla, var_to_perm, permNum = 1000, seed = 42) library(ptestR) library(sdamr)  data("anchoring")  grouped_perm_glmm(   anchoring,   everest_feet ~ anchor + sex + (1 | referrer),   "everest_feet",   permNum = 1000,   seed = 42 ) df %>%   dplyr::group_by(State) %>%   tidyr::nest() %>%   dplyr::mutate(     mk = purrr::map(data, ~ grouped_perm_glmm(       .x,       formla      = feature ~ PMA + PND + Sex + motion_outliers + (1 | subject),       var_to_perm = "feature",       permNum     = 10000,       seed        = 42     ))   ) %>%   tidyr::unnest(mk) %>%   dplyr::filter(term == "PMA")

title: ptestR — Permutation Tests for R
text: Permutation test binomial logistic regression. Returns tibble columns: term, estimate, statistic, p.value, p.perm. Example:
code: grouped_perm_binoglm(tbl, formla, var_to_perm, permNum = 1000, seed = 42) counts <- c(10, 11, 8, 9, 6, 3, 5, 1) gender <- c(0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1) TBL    <- data.frame(counts, gender)  grouped_perm_binoglm(TBL, gender ~ counts, "gender", permNum = 500, seed = 1)

title: ptestR — Permutation Tests for R
text: three functions return tibble. columns common functions : p.perm = 0 means permuted statistic extreme observed one given permNum iterations; report p < 1/permNum (e.g. p < 0.0001 permNum = 10000).

title: ptestR 0.1.1
text: Restructured package CRAN-style hygiene: proper DESCRIPTION, URL, BugReports. Consolidated duplicated get_newp() helper R/utils.R. Replaced require() calls @importFrom declarations throughout. Added @importFrom stats glm gaussian binomial silence R CMD check notes. Added R/ptestR-package.R package-level documentation. Added tests/testthat/ 3 tests per exported function. Added _pkgdown.yml Bootstrap 5 theme package colour palette. Added .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml CI across ubuntu, macOS, Windows. Added hex sticker logo (man/figures/logo.svg).
